title: Head Of Product Design (Ui/Ux, Ai-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Network Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Network Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must have:

- Engineer or Technologist of systems or telecommunications, in computer science or related, with experience in management of local area networks (wired/wireless) for more 2000 virtual /physical devices and extended datacenter supporting critical business environments.

- Creation/Editing medium and high critical configuration scripts for new environments/ troubleshooting/ remediation scenario.

- Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

- Experience for configuration, troubleshooting, testing, IMAC for access/border/core network for Cisco/HP Family.

- This Family comprises small/medium switches L2/L3, small/medium/large Router L3-L7 for access/edge/core, WLAN Cisco/HP

- This CoE wants coverage firewalls Palo Alto, SASE - apply policies/rules/group member/individual

- Identification, testing and built cabling CAT5-9, fiberoptics MM/SM

- Testing for data communication radio & mobile access

- Knowledge for NSX /Virtualization network

- Active Directory/ Radius/802.1x/ MFA authentication.

- Palo Alto Firewall / Windows Jump Server configuration.

- Palo Alto VPN.

- Panorama and Cortex Management for large number of devices.

- Prepare, validate and conduct change Management process.

- Capacity/Performance analysis (CPU, Mem, throughput ports).

- Good Communication skills.

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

.

Good to have:

- Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

- Knowledge Fortinet/Huawei for network (LAN/WLAN) and security devices.

- Firewalls Paloalto and network security administration.

- Palo Alto Panorama and large number of firewall visibility and administration.

- Setup, configuration, integration, design, zero trust. Rules optimization, IP Policy and documentation

- Hardening, standard setup to prod preparation, capacity planning, high availability and failover

- Virtual and appliances devices, cloud and on prem, backup & Restore.

- VPN IPsec and Client to site implementation

- Integration with other security team members from threat intel, SOC

- Experience for EndUser support in record, diagnose and solve problems in the scope of microcomputing, hardware, operating systems, telephony, videoconferencing, web conferencing, audio conferencing and related areas, including performing any corrective maintenance on ICT equipment;

- Experience to clarify doubts and guide users regarding the use, availability, installation and configuration of software, applications, information systems (both those in the market and those developed internally), equipment, standards and procedures on the technological environment of the Customer and its use

- Identify and immediately report to the Level 2 Service Supervisor critical problems that have significant impacts on the technological environment of Customer, exceptional situations and other situations beyond its control or jurisdiction.

- Perform analysis of the hardware requirements for software installation.

- Test functionalities of new equipment, components or peripherals, and prepare configuration and user guides or manuals;

- Act in the execution of activities of the asset management process in Customer locations where there are no asset technicians allocated, at times when the Asset Management service is not available or whenever required by supervision.

- Understand cybersecurity attacks, mitigation methods.

Key responsibilities:

The network Associate is responsible for the LAN, WAN, WLAN or SDWAN Network. On LANs, WANs, WLANs, SDWANs, it is responsible for addressing, switches, routers, WiFi related devices, AD, DNS, NPM, Firewalls, CDN's, Balancers, NFV. In the WAN he is responsible for private networks and the Internet, and assists in the adoption of monitoring and data collection tools in the network. Supports carrier trunking with the local network, and participate on complex Network Setups.

What can you expect from us?

- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

- A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

description:

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Gis
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Sobre a Função


Desafio:

Integrar a equipe de tecnologia, sendo responsável por projetar, implementar e manter soluções que envolvem dados geoespaciais. Atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações web, desktop ou mobile que utilizem sistemas de informação geográfica, integrando ferramentas GIS com bancos de dados e demais sistemas corporativos.


Atividades principais:


  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicações GIS desktop, web e mobile utilizando plataformas da Esri ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS API for JavaScript);

  • Integrar sistemas GIS com outras plataformas empresariais;
  • Desenvolver e manter bancos de dados geoespaciais robustos (PostgreSQL/Hana Spatial);
  • Modelar e estruturar dados geoespaciais (vetoriais e raster) para atender às necessidades das áreas de negócio;
  • Trabalhar com diferentes fontes de dados (satélite, drones, GPS, levantamentos de campo);
  • Prestar suporte técnico especializado aos usuários das soluções florestais;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica detalhada das aplicações e processos desenvolvidos;

Qualificações:

Conhecimentos em programação e experiência prática com plataformas e bibliotecas GIS, além de demonstrar capacidade analítica para manipulação de dados geográficos e automatizar processos espaciais.

title: Project Manager Sênior
description:
Project Manager Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por conduzir a execução de projetos estratégicos, garantindo que cada etapa — do planejamento ao deploy — aconteça dentro dos prazos, orçamentos e expectativas estabelecidas. Seu papel envolve coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, monitorar riscos, assegurar uma comunicação eficaz entre todas as partes envolvidas e garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Acompanhar o progresso de cada fase do projeto (refinamento, planejamento, desenvolvimento, testes, homologação, deploy e operação assistida), garantindo que as entregas ocorram dentro do cronograma e com qualidade;
  • Monitorar e reportar o andamento das atividades, promovendo visibilidade e alinhamento constante com stakeholders;
  • Validar o planejamento de sprints e prioridades, garantindo aderência aos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Gerir recursos humanos e financeiros, assegurando a eficiência na alocação e uso dos investimentos;
  • Produzir materiais e relatórios de status para comitês executivos e áreas envolvidas;
  • Atuar na mitigação de riscos e na remoção de impedimentos que possam impactar o sucesso do projeto.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos corporativos complexos, preferencialmente no setor financeiro, de energia ou utilities;
  • Capacidade de coordenação entre múltiplas áreas, mantendo alinhamento entre tecnologia, negócio e stakeholders;
  • Domínio em monitoramento de prazos, gestão de riscos e orçamentação de projetos;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e executiva;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento de software (refinamento, testes, deploy e operação assistida).


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver background financeiro ou experiência direta com gestão orçamentária e controle de custos;
  • Já tiver atuadoem projetos de transformação digital ou inovação;
  • Possuir certificações como PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM ou afins;
  • Demonstrar habilidade para traduzir necessidades estratégicas em planos de execução práticos;
  • Tiver facilidade em construir relações de confiança e colaboração entre times técnicos e executivos.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Sr. Program Manager Office
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

We are seeking a Program Manager on a contract basis. In this role, you will lead complex cross-functional programs that advance the PMO’s FY26 strategy for operational excellence. You will strengthen program management processes, introduce governance standards, and drive adoption of best practices across multiple teams.

Your impact will be measurable—helping streamline operations, reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enable smarter decision-making. The initial contract length is three months with a strong possibility of extension based on performance.

In this role, you will be expected to lead complex cross-functional programs that drive a range of capabilities, including supporting strategic planning, portfolio management and governance, and ad hoc initiatives for leadership. You will also play a key role in maturing program management processes, tools, and systems across teams.

Key to this role is the ability to gather and document business requirements for internal tools and systems and translate them into Technical Design Documents for submission to software development teams. You will also assist the tools and systems lead in the BPR PMO prioritize the product backlog of feature requests across multiple tools and systems. Central to your success will be the development and execution of a strong change management and communications strategy that enables smooth transitions and lasting impact.



Responsibilities:

  • Act as a business analyst to gather requirements across different functional teams, translate them into design documents and user journeys for submission to software development teams.
  • Create use case scenarios and end user journeys for multiple processes.
  • Create testing plans as well as tracking systems to ensure timely completion of testing.
  • Lead testing efforts and walk business user acceptance testers through the testing process.
  • Create end-user documentation and training materials.
  • Build business cases for prioritized projects and create leadership presentations to secure advocacy and resourcing.
  • Assess tools and systems used across functions;
    recommend consolidationand implement governance standards.
  • Define metrics and reporting to track progress and measure success;
    establish dashboards and scorecards.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional projects while demonstrating excellence in program and portfolio management.
  • Develop standardized templates, frameworks, and operating structures;
    drive adoption across teams.
  • Know where to drive standardization and where to allow for flexibility and creativity.
  • Deploy strong change management and communication strategies to ensure smooth transitions.
  • Facilitate meetings including driving the agenda and driving to closure on key decisions.
  • Take over PMO related tasks to run day-to-day operations and reporting.


Required Skills:

  • Solid experience managing and leading complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of project, program, and portfolio planning with the ability to propose standards, set policies, and coach others.
  • Deep knowledge of end-to-end business processes within a high-tech manufacturing or operations environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive large-scale initiatives under pressure, complexity, and ambiguity.
  • Experience leading strategy and change across diverse, global teams.
  • Fluent English


Nice to Have Skills:

  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma and DMAIC methodologies.
  • Familiarity with program and project management frameworks such as Agile, Kanban, Waterfall, and SDLC.
  • Prior consulting experience with Big 4 firms.
  • Experience in a large, global technology company.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

About Woodgrove


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.


All resumes must be in english.

  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

Sobre o Grupo Multilaser

O Grupo Multilaser foi fundado em 1987. Desde lá, seguimos crescendo, ampliando mercado e construindo parcerias duradouras junto aos nossos colaboradores, consumidores, clientes e investidores.


Temos 4 atributos importantes que nos definem: somos democráticos, humanos, antenados e descontraídos. Um dos nossos principais pilares é facilitar a vida das pessoas através da tecnologia. Em nossa Cultura, temos 3 pilares que nos orientam e direcionam: Gerar valor ao cliente, Fazer o certo do jeito certo e Sinceridade com Respeito.


Atuamos em mais de 15 categorias, temos 3 fábricas no Brasil e um laboratório na China, além dos escritórios em São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. São mais de 5 mil itens em portfólio, presentes em mais de 40 mil pontos de venda e em mais de 30 marketplaces parceiros.

title: Associate Sales Manager
description:
Associate Sales Manager – Sao Paolo

Multinational company is looking for a Sales Manager team lead, in charge of leading 3 team members and carrying their own quota. This is a hybrid role where you would have to go to the office 3 days a week.


Job purpose:

To lead a group of 3 – 4 Sales Associates in their day-to-day sales activity. To drive revenue growth through managing your team with their opportunity portfolio, personal marketing activity & personal development. Your role will be compounded by owning your own opportunity portfolio as well;
supporting clients in assessing their Human Capital Management strategy & demonstrating why ADP should be their chosen partner.


Key objectives:

  • Responsible for the development & maintenance of a comprehensive plan for team sales activity including pipeline and productivity. Responsible for managing both personal and team quota.
  • Responsible for supporting the wider Leadership group of all active sales processes within the team, ensuring co-ordination of company resource in an optimal and effective manner.
  • To fulfil the standard accountabilities of a Sales Associate in addition to the above objectives.


Key duties/tasks:

  • To monitor the performance of the team daily, co-ordinating resource, monitoring activity, and where necessary initiating corrective action with Regional Sales Manager to ensure sustainable delivery of results.
  • To generate new business through inbound leads but also personal marketing efforts.
  • To execute on personal quota plus part of team target
  • To manage sales opportunities through direct reports
  • Weekly team & leadership sales forecasting.
  • To work alongside your fellow Leaders in identifying training & development needs across the wider team.
  • Delivering training sessions (ad-hoc)
  • To submit the relevant management reports in a timely manner including up to date forecasting information.
  • Be result driven to ensure a laser focus on overachievement on quota.
  • Responsible for the direction of the team with regards to training, engagement & development.
  • Member of the sales leadership team.


Skills and knowledge:

  • Ability to anticipate, identify and analyse problems and opportunities, establish priorities and effectively apply resolutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of commercial/sales issues preferably within a Payroll/HR software and service environment.
  • Ability to review and measure progress against specific criteria and take necessary corrective action where appropriate.
  • Must be able to demonstrate excellent communication skills, personal integrity and a positive attitude in all dealings with colleagues/clients.


Education and experience:

  • Must be able to demonstrate extensive direct selling experience, preferably within a Payroll/HR software and service environment and consistent over performance
  • Team Leader/Sales Management experience (desirable).

title: Actuarial Director (Portfolio Management)
description:
We are seeking a strategic leader to head our Actuarial division during a pivotal phase of transformation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in finance and data analysis, who can translate complex information into decisions that drive business performance across portfolios.


Key Responsibilities


  • Champion the company’s analytics vision by embedding data into strategic decision-making and portfolio oversight.
  • Build and lead a high-performing, multicultural analytics team from the ground up, aligned with evolving business priorities.
  • Establish scalable processes and best practices to ensure consistent, high-impact delivery of insights.
  • Partner directly with executive leadership to define key performance indicators, shape business strategy, and deliver actionable recommendations.
  • Lead time-sensitive initiatives with precision, ensuring insights are timely and relevant to business needs.
  • Translate complex data into clear, strategic guidance that supports measurable outcomes across portfolios.
  • Use data to uncover growth opportunities, solve business challenges, and optimize portfolio performance.
  • Oversee the development and deployment of predictive models and AI tools, ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Communicate analytical findings in a clear and compelling way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science or Statistics
  • Prior experience in Insurance
  • Advanced SQL and Python for data modeling, forecasting, and auditing.
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI (Data visualization).
  • Ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Solid foundation in data science and analytics methodologies.
  • Understanding of data’s role in driving innovation in regulated industries.
  • Adoption and scalability of analytics processes across the organization.
  • Team growth and effectiveness across multiple business lines.
  • Familiarity with metrics such as GWP, NB, Retention Rate, Win Rate, Loss Ratio, PIF, and more.
  • Fluent in English (will be tested)

title: Supervisor(A) Operacional De Bar
description:
Principais responsabilidades

Gestão operacional

- Coordenar o funcionamento diário do bar, garantindo abertura, operação e fechamento conforme os padrões definidos.

- Supervisionar equipe de salão (garçons), cozinha (cozinheiros e auxiliares) e bar.

- Garantir a comunicação fluida entre as áreas para manter agilidade e qualidade de atendimento.

- Controlar escalas, pontualidade, uniformes e postura da equipe com empatia, clareza e responsabilidade.

- Apoiar o recrutamento e a seleção de novos membros da equipe, conduzindo entrevistas e validando contratações junto aos sócios.

Gestão de estoque e insumos

- Supervisionar pedidos, recebimento e armazenamento de bebidas, alimentos e materiais de limpeza.

- Monitorar o giro de estoque e evitar desperdícios.

- Fazer inventário periódico de bebidas e insumos de cozinha.

Qualidade e experiência do cliente

- Garantir que cada noite na Firma seja uma experiência memorável, acolhedora e autêntica.

- Observar feedbacks de clientes e propor melhorias contínuas, valorizando a cultura e a diversidade do público.

- Assegurar que ambientação, trilha, limpeza e apresentação estejam sempre alinhadas à identidade do espaço.

Liderança e cultura

- Engajar e desenvolver a equipe, fortalecendo o senso de pertencimento e profissionalismo.

- Participar de reuniões com os sócios para apresentar resultados e propor melhorias.

- Manter o equilíbrio entre eficiência operacional e o clima criativo, diverso e descontraído que define a Firma.


Requisitos

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos em gestão operacional de bares, restaurantes ou casas noturnas.

- Domínio prático de rotinas de cozinha, bar e salão (fluxo de pedidos, controle de CMV, armazenamento e manipulação de alimentos).

- Capacidade de liderança com postura firme, empática e justa.

- Organização, autonomia e maturidade para resolver problemas e manter a operação fluindo.

- Conhecimento básico de controle financeiro e indicadores de operação (vendas, CMV e custos).

- Desejável conhecimento sobre vigilância sanitária e boas práticas de manipulação.

- Disponibilidade para trabalhar à noite e aos fins de semana.


Perfil desejado

- Líder presente, que saiba conduzir pessoas com equilíbrio entre exigência e escuta.

- Perfil organizado, proativo e resolutivo, que consiga tomar decisões rápidas mantendo a harmonia da equipe.

- Capacidade de manter o padrão mesmo sob pressão e volume alto de clientes.

- Boa comunicação interpessoal e foco na experiência de quem está no espaço.

- Espírito aberto, genuíno e livre de preconceitos.

- Apoia e valoriza a diversidade, a arte e a pluralidade de expressões que fazem parte do DNA da Firma.

- Afinidade com o conceito da marca: um espaço cultural e contemporâneo, onde pessoas, música, arte e boa comida se encontram.


Diferenciais

- Conhecimento em sistemas de PDV e gestão de estoque.

- Experiência com eventos, DJs, exposições e ativações culturais.

- Vivência anterior em bares ou casas que valorizem liberdade artística e público jovem e diverso.

title: Pessoa Executiva De Soluções De Negócios - Farmer
description:
Garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela TOTVS, cultivar e expandir o relacionamento com clientes existentes em um território específico, garantindo a sua satisfação contínua e maximizando as oportunidades de receita dentro dessas contas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir sua carteira de clientes e construir um relacionamento visando rentabilizar, blindar e elevar o nível de satisfação da base TOTVS em relação às responsabilidades do Atendimento e Relacionamento (AR) nos indicadores de NPS (Farmer);
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos: Entender profundamente as necessidades, desafios e objetivos de cada cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de upselling e cross-selling: Oferecer produtos/serviços adicionais que agreguem valor ao cliente;
  • Garantir a retenção de clientes: Minimizar o churn e fidelizar os clientes a longo prazo;
  • Atuar como um consultor de confiança: Oferecer insights e soluções que ajudem o cliente a alcançar seus objetivos;
  • Elaborar e executar o plano tático alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da unidade TOTVS e dos resultados de vendas no segmento/região de atuação;
  • Elaborar propostas no CRM, negociando e fechando os contratos com o cliente;
  • Gerir o funil de vendas, identificando e qualificando oportunidades de negócio, a fim de garantir o atingimento das metas estabelecidas pela TOTVS;
  • Acompanhar e manter todos os dados relativos à trajetória dos clientes (empresas/oportunidades) atualizados no CRM, tais como: registro de visitas comerciais, follow up de atividades e fatos relevantes;
  • Antecipar e diagnosticar demandas de clientes e prospects, conhecendo as necessidades e tendências do mercado/segmento;
  • Facilitar a resolução de demandas dos clientes e prospects, articulando com profissionais ou áreas internas responsáveis;
  • Atender os leads gerados pela área de Negócios e Prospecção no ciclo completo de vendas;
  • Registrar no CRM e comunicar a área de Estratégia Comercial/Operações e Segmentos, informações relevantes sobre mercado/carteira;
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de entrega dos produtos e serviços comercializados pela TOTVS, apoiando nas soluções dos eventuais problemas;
  • Realizar o pós-venda junto aos clientes TOTVS, garantindo a satisfação e retenção do cliente, além de gerar novas oportunidades;
  • Report de pipeline e forecast no CRM, utilizando a metodologia do TOTVS Vende e garantindo visibilidade do potencial de negócios;
  • Informar e garantir a participação dos seus clientes/prospects em eventos/treinamentos;
  • Orientar Executivos mais juniores em visitas a clientes e/ou prospects, dominando e repassando conhecimentos sobre abordagens comerciais e formas de atuação de acordo com o perfil/segmento do cliente/prospect;
  • Estar atualizado com as tendências do segmento de atuação, buscando novos modelos de negócios pautados em tecnologia;
  • Desenvolver abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções cross voltadas aos segmentos de atuação que propiciem a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação: Graduação completa, preferencialmente no segmento de atuação.

Cursando Pós Graduação, Especialização ou MBA.


Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Pacote Office – Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Pacote Google Workspace avançado;
  • Ferramentas de BI;
  • Prospecção;
  • Vendas Consultivas;
  • Metodologia de Atendimento;
  • Mercado e Segmento de atuação.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • CRM – desejável;
  • Inglês ou Espanhol intermediário
  • Desejável vivência de, no mínimo, 02 anos em áreas de vendas.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models;
    design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts;
    replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code;
    optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed;
    measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week;
    decreased cycle time;
    reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.G., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ;
    Postgres/Redis;
    REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends;
    write clean, testable code;
    and deploy via CI/CD toa major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics;
    you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity;
    you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.G., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.G., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.Io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.Js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.Io/Cloudflare + Docker;
    CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful;
    evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn >
    Perfect:     Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first;
    quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  1. Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  2. Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation;
    explain trade-offs.
  3. Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  4. Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

The Data Integration Specialist designs and implements the technical infrastructure needed to consolidate the school’s data into a centralized repository. The specialist also supports the creation of dashboards and visualizations in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom web applications, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions.

  • Collaborate with the Systems & Data Admin to validate that technical outputs meet business needs.

Qualifications


Candidates should bring most or all of the following:

  • Solid experience in a similar role.

  • Ability to design data models and schemas for reporting.Strong technical skills in data integration (APIs, SQL, CSV, ETL).
  • Proficiency with visualization tools (Looker Studio, Power BI).Proficiency with Python for data manipulation and system integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud automation tools (Microsoft Data Factory, Power Automate).
  • Ability to support and maintain custom dashboards and webapps (Azure, Python, Angular, Bootstrap).Use of Git/version control and documentation for maintainability.
  • Apply data quality assurance practices: cleaning, validating, monitoring pipelines.
  • Shows humility and confidence.
  • Tech "positive" - see upsides and opportunities in using tech for learning

Olá! Obrigado pela sua curiosidade

O candidato ideal é proativo, orientado a resultados e apaixonado por vendas e pelo universo da entrega de última milha .


Quem somos

A Zubale é uma empresa de tecnologia que ajuda os varejistas a vencer no e-commerce.

Atendemos uma ampla gama de varejistas — desde supermercados, lojas especializadas, farmácias, lojas de departamento e marcas de moda — em México, Brasil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru e Colômbia. Como fazemos isso?

Temos dois principais produtos:

  • Flexifleet: Marketplace de freelancers para realizar tarefas de picking, packing e delivery para varejistas e agregadores.
  • Consumer Connect: Plataforma de comércio conversacional via WhatsApp com IA para impulsionar vendas e aprimorar a experiência do cliente.

Somos apaixonados por ajudar marcas, agregadores e varejistas a otimizar suas operações de e-commerce, reduzir custos e aumentar a lucratividade.

Com mais de US$ 70 milhões em capital de risco , crescemos de forma consistente nos últimos seis anos e já completamos mais de 150 milhões de pedidos através da nossa plataforma.

Hoje, atendemos mais de 100 clientes e contamos com milhares de freelancers em nossa rede.

E isso é apenas o começo — estamos construindo um ecossistema rentável e escalável , com o objetivo de nos tornarmos o parceiro nº 1 dos varejistas para acelerar seus negócios de e-commerce.


Quem é você

Você é um profissional de vendas orientado a resultados , com mais de 3 anos de experiência comprovada superando metas de forma consistente. Possui um perfil analítico, com forte disciplina na medição e acompanhamento de indicadores para embasar decisões estratégicas.

Tem experiência anterior no setor de varejo , especialmente com supermercados ou aplicativos tipo iFood, Rappi, 99 etc. Gosta de ambientes dinâmicos e está pronto para usar sua experiência para gerar crescimento acelerado de receita .


O que você fará

  • Construir parcerias estratégicas: desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo com tomadores de decisão, aproveitando sua rede de contatos para identificar e conquistar novas oportunidades de negócio.

  • Analisar mercado e concorrência: realizar análises contínuas de mercado e concorrentes para antecipar tendências e ajustar táticas comerciais.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração: alinhar-se de perto com as áreas de Marketing, Produto e Operações para garantir a satisfação do cliente e entregar soluções integradas e personalizadas.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência comprovada em vendas B2B , com histórico de superação de metas.
  • Forte orientação a resultados , com experiência em fechamento e expansão de contas-chave.
  • Domínio de vendas consultivas e baseadas em soluções , com capacidade de entender as necessidades do cliente e propor soluções sob medida.
  • Inglês intermediário para comunicação de negócios.
  • Alta disciplina comercial — gestão estruturada de pipeline, precisão no CRM e acompanhamento rigoroso.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado por dados , capaz de extrair insights e tomar decisões com base em números.
  • Experiência prévia com vendas para supermercados, varejistas ou marketplaces (como iFood, Rappi, 99 ou similares).

title: Principal Architect
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.


The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

title: Analista De Gente E Performance Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in several primary practice areas – ports and harbors;
coastal, environmental and water resources;
urban waterfronts and marinas;
transportation, bridgesand rail;
inspection and rehabilitation;
and energy.

title: Cientista De Dados Pleno
description:

  • Base sólida em estatística e testes de hipóteses ;
  • Habilidade em visualização de dados (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI ou equivalentes);

Estamos construindo uma área de dados moderna, escalável e com papel estratégico no crescimento da Privacy.


Aqui, você terá autonomia para testar hipóteses, desenvolver modelos preditivos e contribuir diretamente para decisões que impactam milhões de pessoas.

title: Especialista De Controles Internos

Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo.

Somos um time de mais de 33 mil colaboradores que perseguem o mesmo compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável e valores corporativos: Paixão pela Inovação, Empreendedorismo, Espírito de Equipe, Profissionalismo e Respeito pelas Pessoas.

  • Rever os principais procedimentos e estrutura de controles locais;

O que buscamos?

description:
We’re Hiring!


Commercial Performance Specialist EMEA LATAM


At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.

We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.


Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)


FUNCTION: Commercial Performance Specialist EMEA LATAM

LOCATION: Zona Sul, São Paulo, Brazil

JOB TYPE: Indeterminado

ROLE SENIORITY: Managerial


GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:


As part of the Commercial Excellence EMEA LATAM team, the Commercial Performance Specialist plays a key role in driving the execution and deployment of commercial excellence initiatives across the region to ensure sustainable business growth. This role acts as a strategic link between Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Service and Commercial Excellence, ensuring alignment between market dynamics and internal execution through clear dashboards, tools, and governance processes.


This role will focus on 3 key areas: price setup and profitability management, development of commercial policies (Commercial Policy), and sales contract optimization.


By enabling robust pricing processes, effective cross-selling, and stronger customer agreements, you will directly contribute to improved customer loyalty and long-term sustainable business continuity.


YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:


1. Price Setup & Profitability Management

Centralize and harmonize price lists across country clusters and market segments.

Conduct profitability and business impact simulations to guide strategic pricing decisions.

Ensure process consistency, data accuracy and timely loading of prices in D365 (ERP).

Contribute to monitoring pricing effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.


2. Commercial Policy Development (Commercial Police)

Design, implement, and refine commercial policies to support cross-selling and upselling,

Leverage & analyze sell-out data to help commercial teams define customer based cross- and up-selling targets.

Identify and drive initiatives to improve gross-to-net performance in consistency with customer prioritization.

Partner with Sales, Marketing and Finance to align commercial policies with strategic objectives and optimize service level.


3. Sales Contracts & Terms Optimization

Collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Sales to develop and optimize sales contract terms and conditions to foster customer retention.

Ensure contracts balance commercial competitiveness with profitability, risk management and longer-term partnerships that reinforce business continuity.

Standardize and streamline contract processes.


ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Engineering, or related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Effectiveness, Business Analytics, or similar roles.
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI (or equivalent tools).
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Dynamics 365 preferred).
  • Knowledge of pricing, rebates, and Go-to-Market models.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese required;
    Spanish is a strong advantage.
  • Ability to work across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.


Key Competencies


  • Strategic thinking with strong business acumen.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • High level of ownership, autonomy, and accountability.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in a multicultural environment.


Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.


By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

This role will be the S4 HANA Technical Expert for General Accounting and the Period Close process within Mars for the Development and Deployment of our S4 HANA global landscape.


This role will the expected to have S4 HANA hands on knowledge along with development and deployment experience in the area of General Accounting and the Period Close. This role is also expected to bring the newest technology innovations from SAP to be incorporated in the system and process design.


What are we looking for?


  • Must have hands-on experience with the design and build of the General Accounting and the Period Close area within the S4 HANA platform.
  • Must have experience with large S4 HANA deployments within the S4 HANA General Accounting and the Period Close area.
  • Must have experience with global design and implementation projects with General Accounting and the Period Close area for S4 HANA.
  • Must be able to configure and develop S4 HANA for General Accounting and the Period Close area.


What will be your key responsibilities?


  • S4 SAP Technical Expertise : Oversee the design, development, and implementation of financial solutions that align with business requirements and industry standards.
  • Template Design: Collaborate with third-party partners, cross-functional teams, and other finance teams, including edge teams, to design and build an S4 HANA shared template for all of Mars Inc.'s businesses.
  • Technical Documentation Review: Review, provide feedback, and sign off on all technical documentation (CRD, CSD, FSD, FUT, etc.) to ensure accuracy and completeness, as well as ensure adherence to best practices.
  • Testing and Defect Resolution Support: Oversee testing processes by reviewing test plans, scripts, and results. Assist with defect resolution and approving solutions for defect closure.


What can you expect from Mars?


  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

title: Diretor Comercial De Fragrâncias Latam
description:
Buscamos um profissional para atuar como DIRETOR COMERCIAL DE FRAGRÂNCIAS LATAM em uma grande multinacional com foco em fragrâncias e sabores, que faz parte de um dos maiores grupos internacionais, com atuação mundial nos mercados de perfumes, cosméticos e produtos de higiene pessoal, consumo, alimentos e bebidas.

Será responsável pela gestão comercial da divisão fragrâncias, implementando plano estratégico e liderando a equipe na região da América Latina e as ações do dia a dia e garantindo o crescimento sustentável dos negócios.


REQUISITOS E EXPERIÊNCIA:

  • Formação: Administração, Marketing, Matemática, Engenharia, Química ou Farmácia.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA é desejável.
  • Inglês Fluente será fundamental.
  • Espanhol Fluente.
  • 8-10 anos na área de fragrância, com mínimo de 5 anos em posições de gestão de equipe de vendas e gerenciamento de contas chave no setor.
  • Experiência no mercado de fragrância fina, seja em casa de fragrância ou em empresa do mercado de consumo que atua com produtos onde fragrância fina seja uma das principais insumos.
  • Experiência e contato com as grandes empresas do setor de perfumaria que atuam no mercado brasileiro.
  • Preferencialmente, que tenha tido experiência profissional que combina permanência empresas multinacionais de Cosméticos, Bens de Consumo, Perfumes ou Química fina.
  • Boa reputação nos clientes / mercado brasileiro e regional de Fragrâncias.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais.


RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Desenvolver e implementar plano estratégico comercial da divisão de fragrâncias visando melhorar os resultados e garantir crescimento sustentável dos negócios.
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de crescimento, condução efetiva de uma equipe de vendas vencedora que una força comercial, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e forte relacionamento.
  • Identificar oportunidades e construir proposta de valor comercial para conquista de novos mercados e clientes.
  • Gestão e cumprimento de metas relativas a vendas, Gross Profit, Pipeline e despesas relativas à sua área, conforme definido no budget.
  • Participar ativamente da política de definição de preços, mark-up, custos e demais condições comerciais.
  • Promover a devida gestão de pessoas visando contratar, desenvolver e reter os melhores talentos para divisão de fragrâncias.
  • Garantir a integração da área de vendas às demais áreas chave da divisão P&D, Supply-chain, etc.
  • Assegurar o alinhamento da estratégia comercial aos objetivos financeiros e operacionais da empresa.
  • Gerenciar as políticas comerciais de modo que assegurem a saúde financeira da divisão fragrâncias.
  • Gestão de contas estratégicas para fortalecer o relacionamento e assegurar o crescimento e rentabilidade dos negócios.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, feiras e reuniões com stakeholders estratégicos.
  • Criação e acompanhamento de indicadores e metas para sua equipe visando melhoria de desempenho.


COMPLETAM O PERFIL:

  • Perfil estratégico com visão analítica e foco em resultados/clientes.
  • Organização e planejamento.
  • Liderança e habilidade na gestão de pessoas.
  • Criatividade.
  • Carisma/agregador com espírito de equipe.
  • Segurança na tomada de decisões.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz com diferentes públicos.
  • Saber ouvir e ter empatia.


REMUNERAÇÃO:

  • Pacote atraente com faixa salarial e bônus.
  • Benefícios completos.


LOCAL DE TRABALHO:

  • São Paulo Capital.

Sobre a Stepan:

Fundada em 1932, a Stepan Company é uma importante fabricante de produtos químicos básicos e intermediários, incluindo surfactantes, polímeros, bem como ingredientes especiais que entram em produtos de consumo, domésticos e institucionais, como detergentes para roupas, xampus e limpadores de superfícies. A Stepan Company possui atualmente 20 fábricas globais e mais de 2.000 funcionários. Temos um forte histórico de crescimento. Nosso crescimento nos permite oferecer oportunidades de carreira significativas e estabilidade aos membros de nossa equipe. Temos grandes objetivos na Stepan e sabemos que cada membro da equipe será crucial para alcançar nossos objetivos. Independentemente da função, procuramos membros da equipe que tragam consigo uma mentalidade de crescimento, um espírito empreendedor e a capacidade de prosperar em um ambiente em evolução.

Celebramos a diversidade na Stepan e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente diversificado e inclusivo. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, informações genéticas, deficiência, idade, status de veterano ou qualquer outro status protegido pela lei aplicável.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

- Boa capacidade de comunicação para abordar targets e construir relacionamento com seus sócios/representantes.

- Experiência em M&A, Venture Capital e áreas relacionadas será um diferencial.

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

● Automatizar relatórios de auditoria e acompanhar KPIs de qualidade de dados (completeness, accuracy, timeliness).

● Aplicar análises exploratórias e modelos preditivos que revelem oportunidades para impulsionar engajamento e performance das campanhas.

● Trabalhar lado a lado com squads de Marketing, Produto e Tecnologia, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em dashboards, alertas ou APIs de dados .

● Documentar processos, compartilhar conhecimento e cultivar um ambiente colaborativo .

● Desenvolvimento de rotinas automatizadas para sincronização de dados entre diferentes plataformas;


Requisitos obrigatórios

● Perfil analítico e consultivo

● Power BI avançado (DAX, Power Query, publicação e gateways).

● SQL sólido em SQL Server e PostgreSQL (criação de views, stored procedures, tuning).

● ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga) Integração de Dados : Capacidade de extrair dados de diferentes fontes (bancos de dados, arquivos CSV, APIs, etc.), transformá-los em um formato adequado e carregá-los no Power BI.

● Habilidades em Python e outras linguagens de análise de dados.

● Uso do Power Query: Habilidade em utilizar o Power Query para realizar transformações de dados, como limpeza, filtragem e agregação.

● Perfil proativo, prestativo e orientado a resultados , com capacidade de comunicar insights a públicos não técnicos.

● Vivência na construção e manutenção de KPIs, relatórios e dashboards.

● Excelente comunicação para apresentar insights a stakeholders não técnicos.


Diferenciais que contam ponto

● Uso prático do n8n para automatização de processos e integrações.

● Experiência em BI voltado a campanhas de incentivo (lifecycle, cohort, ROI de promoções).

● Certificações Microsoft (Power BI Data Analyst, Azure Data Engineer) ou equivalentes.


Por que se juntar a nós?

● Ambiente colaborativo, com autonomia para propor e testar novas soluções.

● Projetos de alto impacto nacional, com dados reais de milhões de interações.

● Cultura de aprendizado contínuo.

Temos dois principais produtos:

Hoje, atendemos mais de 100 clientes e contamos com milhares de freelancers em nossa rede.

title: Finance & Investor Relations Analyst
description:
About Us

Billor is building the largest Trucking Ecosystem in the United States, combining Freight and Technology for Truck Drivers, Freight Brokers, and Autonomous Trucks, creating higher efficiency, stronger margins, and a more connected supply chain.


About the role

We’re looking for a Finance & Investor Relations Analyst to own the core financial model, forecasts, and investor reporting process. This person will be at the intersection of finance and strategy, maintaining the company’s financial projections, supporting capital raises, and acting as the first point of contact with investors before engaging the leadership team.



Responsabilities


  • Maintain and update Billor’s financial model, VDR’s, forecasts, and key performance dashboards.
  • Support the preparation of monthly investor reports, internal financial reviews, and board materials.
  • Lead initial investor outreach and communications, scheduling and conducting introductory meetings.
  • Prepare financial decks, projections, and summaries for investor follow-ups.
  • Conduct financial analysis to evaluate new initiatives, leasing programs, or SPV structures.
  • Partner with internal teams (Accounting, Freight, Technology) to align financial data and metrics.
  • Support due diligence and documentation during financing rounds and audits.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, investment banking, or investor relations.
  • Advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets and financial modeling.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to engage confidently with investors.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with startup or high-growth environments, particularly in technology and asset-based industries.
  • Familiarity with fundraising, convertible notes, and capital structure modeling.
  • Exposure to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar ERP systems.

- Vivência no tratamento de sinistros e divergências críticas.

- Experiência com sistemas TMS e ferramentas de rastreamento.

description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.

Talent Development & Retention

Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.

Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.

Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.

Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.G., workshops, speakers, EdCamps).


Attracting & Retaining Talent

Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.

Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.

Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.

Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.

Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.

Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.

Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.


Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture

Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.

Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.

Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.

Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.


Compliance and Child Protection

Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.

Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws

Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).

Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.

Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.

Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.


Wellbeing

Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.

Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.

Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.

Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.


Health (physical and mental/emotional)

Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.

Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.

Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.

Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.


Other duties, as assigned.

  • Minimum Education Required: BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
  • Minimum Experience Required: 5+ years of experience

  • Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)

title: Venture Analyst
description:
About Flow Capital

Flow Capital Corp. is a publicly listed provider of flexible growth and alternative capital solutions dedicated to supporting market-leading, high-growth companies. Since 2018, we’ve helped businesses in the US, UK, and Canada access financing that drives growth while minimizing dilution and retaining founder control. Our focus is on revenue-generating, VC-backed, and founder-owned companies seeking growth capital. Learn more at



Overview


We’re looking for an entry-level analyst to join our venture team at Flow Capital. This role sits between our Marketing and Originations teams, starting with a focus on marketing. You’ll support a wide range of activities, including identifying and researching potential investment opportunities and supporting business development, while also contributing to marketing campaigns, content creation, and brand initiatives.

This is an excellent entry point for someone interested in gaining exposure to the venture ecosystem.


  • Location: Remote. Candidates must be available to work North American Eastern Time (GMT-4).
  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Proof of fluency will be required.
  • Please submit your resume in English only.



Responsibilities

  • Conduct research to identify potential investment and partner opportunities.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis (e.G., market sizing, competitive analysis, web analytics data).
  • Support lead generation and outbound email campaign setup, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with marketing to create content, marketing materials and assist with digital initiatives as needed.
  • Track and analyze performance, providing insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Participate in events, webinars, and other initiatives to build Flow Capital’s brand.
  • Manage and update CRM records.



Qualifications

  • Business or a related field degree from a strong academic program.
  • A passion for early stage investing and a desire to be in the Venture Ecosystem.
  • Entry-level role. 0–2 years of experience in venture, business development, or finance preferred, but not required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills.
  • Curious, proactive, eager to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proactive, versatile, and comfortable handling a variety of tasks across marketing functions
  • Familiarity with tools including AI tools, Webflow, HubSpot, Canva, outreach tools (e.G., Reply.Io), PitchBook, SEMrush, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Google Analytics.



Why Join Flow Capital?

  • Be part of a leading Canadian venture debt firm working with high-growth companies.
  • Gain exposure to venture capital, finance, and growth-stage tech ecosystems.
  • Join a small, collaborative team where your work has a direct impact.



Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. Thank you for your interest.
